description: This file defines a utility module for aggregating agent usage and cost data from MongoDB collections, including functions for parsing currency strings, building aggregation pipelines, and merging results.

methods.name: toNumberSafe
methods.description: Parses a string or number safely into a numeric value, handling currency symbols and commas.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost
methods.description: Aggregates agent costs and usage data across session_tracking and llm-costs collections with optional filters and returns summarized results.
